cited.quote: Phase II Waste to Energy project, work is in progress with expected electrical power output of 2.9MWh

rationale: No extract shows guidelines for generating electricity from solid waste. C2 (undated policy note) mentions a Waste to Energy project in progress, which is not guidelines; C3-C5 cover general solid waste rules and bye-laws only.

cited.quote: Phase II Waste to Energy project, work is in progress with expected electrical power output of 2.9MWh

rationale: C2 reports a Waste to Energy project under way in the Vengadamangalam cluster of municipalities, a concrete step toward power from solid waste, but it is an undated policy note with no sanction order shown and no operation. Other extracts concern composting, rules and bye-laws.

cited.quote: Oilseeds of less than 15 years old varieties distributed to the farmers through AECs are alone eligible
distribution of Foundation/Certified seeds of paddy, millets, pulses and oilseeds to the farmers at subsidised cost

rationale: C2 reports subsidised distribution of certified seeds to farmers (scheme implemented 2017-18); C4 is a GO (2018-08-31) fixing per-kg distribution subsidy on certified oilseeds. C1, C3 and C5 show continued procurement and subsidy. Scope matches the promise.

cited.quote: the Tamil Nadu Folk Artistes Welfare Board is providing welfare schemes to the registered folk artistes

rationale: C1-C3 describe the existing activities of the Art and Culture Department. C4 and C5 are building rules on heritage buildings, a different subject. No guidelines to protect sculpture or folk art are shown.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu Folk Artistes Welfare Board was started with a view to provide social security

rationale: C1-C3 describe existing bodies such as the Folk Artistes Welfare Board and the Music and Fine Arts University, with no date or order showing a new committee or scheme formed in this term. C4 and C5 are unrelated GOs.

cited.quote: extended further by one month upto December 2017 so as to enable the Committee to complete its task

rationale: C1-C5 are GOs reconstituting and repeatedly extending the Expert Committee on continuing the old pension scheme, up to December 2017. No extract shows the report obtained or any decision to continue the old pension scheme.

cited.quote: several skill development training programmes are organized through Empanelled Institutes of Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation

rationale: C2 describes skill training for Adi Dravidar youth since 2013-14 and a tribal entrepreneur scheme since 2012-13, both before this government took office. C5 is a general scheme for marginalised groups, not separate entrepreneur training. No new step shown.

cited.quote: The Government after careful consideration of the report of the Official Committee, 2017 has decided to accept its recommendations

rationale: C2 constituted the Official Committee on revising pay after the Seventh Central Pay Commission; C4 (G.O.Ms.No.303, 2017-10-11) accepts its report and notifies the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Rules, 2017, with a Pay Matrix like the Union government's.

cited.quote: Aavin is the largest selling brand in Chennai Metro

rationale: C1-C4 cover Aavin marketing and ordinary milk prices (Rs.17-22.50 per 500 ml). None mentions fortified milk or a Rs 25 litre pack. C5 is a maternity benefit GO. Only related activity is shown.

cited.quote: the construction of 20,000 houses every year commencing from the year 2016-17
40,000 houses are being constructed at an estimated cost of Rs.B40 crore

rationale: C4 (GO of 2017-02-24) sanctions 20,000 solar green houses a year from 2016-17; C3 and C5 repeat 20,000 for 2018-19; C1 sanctions 20,000 for 2020-21. The scheme runs but at about 20,000 a year, far below 10 lakh houses.

cited.quote: TACTV is providing 90 to 100 channels of good quality at an affordable cost of Rs. 70/- to the public

rationale: C1-C3 describe the Rs.70 service begun in 2011, before this government. C4 and C5 are GOs on broadcast infrastructure and dissolving an advisory committee. No notification on continuing low-cost service is shown.

cited.quote: providing 90-100 channels with quality and clarity at an affordable cost of Rs.70/

rationale: C2 and C3 report the Rs.70 subscription as an existing arrangement. C4 is a paid set-top-box approval and C5 a channel-slot sanction. No tariff order is shown.

cited.quote: render all services at the doorstep of the public even at the remotest village through e-Sevai centres in electronic mode

rationale: C1-C3 describe Arasu e-Sevai Centres (launched 2014, before this government) delivering about 140 services. C5 is an e-Governance policy GO. No new dated step moves all government services to e-sevai centres.

cited.quote: take action for procurement of napkins to adolescent Girls in the Urban areas and to women inpatients

rationale: C4 orders napkin procurement through Tamil Nadu Medical Service Corporation, not self-help groups. C1-C3 describe distribution of napkins and Amma Baby Care kits without sourcing from self-help groups. C5 is an unrelated hygiene kit GO.

cited.quote: have issued the Digital Addressable System (DAS) License to Tamil Nadu Arasu Cable TV Corporation on 17.4.2017

rationale: C2 shows TACTV's application and court case; C3 and C1 report that the Union ministry issued the DAS license to TACTV on 17.4.2017. The outcome that only the Union could deliver happened after the government took office.

cited.quote: issued Orders in G.O. (Ms.) No.7, Information Technology (Admin.2) Department dated 30.5.2017 according Administrative Sanction

rationale: C3 reports G.O.(Ms.) No.7 of 30.5.2017 sanctioning the project proposal of digitalization of TACTV, followed by a tender and set-top box procurement. The DAS licence was issued on 17.4.2017, so a government order to provide digital broadcasting exists.

cited.quote: accordingly the same has been implemented from 9.6.2017

rationale: C3 and C2 report that the Valuation Committee rationalised guideline values with a uniform 33% reduction effective 9.6.2017. This is a dedicated measure on guideline value setting, though a one-time revision rather than a changed method, and the extracts show no separate administrative order.

cited.quote: Inspector General of Registration is the chairman of the Central Valuation Committee

rationale: C1-C3 describe the existing Valuation Committee and sub-committees, under which values were last revised from 1.4.2012. No extract shows a new committee set up to review or reform the method. C4 and C5 are unrelated committee GOs.

cited.quote: administrative sanction for construction of hostel for College Girls and lTl students in Royapuram

rationale: C4 (GO of 2019-05-28) gives financial sanction to build a new hostel at Royapuram, and C1 and C5 report hostel construction by TAHDCO. No extract says these replace rented hostels, so only part of the promise is evidenced.

cited.quote: communicate the date of personal hearing within 21 days of filing of the applications

rationale: C1 is a policy note describing time limits for planning permission steps, with no GO fixing a 45-day limit for house site and building plan approvals. C5 sets time limits for industrial clearances, not house sites. C2 allows 2 months for clarifications.
